title: I wish they'd just book
caption:
I wish they'd just book.

"What dates do you have?" "How about the 14th?" "Actually, can we do the week after?" With Snap your client picks a time on your booking page and the booking is made, and "New booking" lands in your Snap inbox.
One session type on the Free plan, 0% commission.

It is not magic: you still set your availability. Snap just makes booking it the easy part.

Start free at snaphq.app
